verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Fireworks is OpenAI API-compatible with tool-calling and structured outputs, which is a prerequisite for agent integration, but there is no documented first-party guide showing integration with specific coding agents or agent frameworks (e.g., LangChain, Cursor, Continue, agent SDKs). Missing for 10: explicit first-party integration guides/tutorials for coding agents or agent frameworks, code samples showing framework hookup, or partner-integration documentation.
